sketch:
Observe: R-C low-pass schematic with R and C sliders; live Bode
plot with the −20 dB/décade asymptote and the flat DC gain
highlighted; the −3 dB point marks f_c = 1/(2πRC). Time-domain
inset shows a step response filling in with time constant τ = RC.
Experiment: choose R and C to hit a target f_c (e.g., 1 kHz for
audio anti-alias). Evaluate: given a Bode magnitude curve, read
f_c and pick the (R, C) pair. Wrinkle: cascade two low-passes and
see the slope steepen to −40 dB/décade.
